editorial: Promoter announcements and cross-checked named pairings from reputable fight schedules; identify any opponent awaiting promoter reconfirmation. Main/prelim placement shown only where evidenced; source links on each event. Event times, opponents and bout order can change. The Dec 5 Saudi Arabia UFC Fight Night is currently reported by independent outlets, not on the official UFC event listing; it is explicitly labelled provisional. Fighter W-L(-D) records are shown where supported by published fighter rosters, WBC/promoter reports or detailed fight schedules; otherwise marked as unverified. Official event posters appear when a reliable source provides one. Fighter records are independently cross-checked using promoter/schedule sources and direct fighter record pages (including Wikipedia, BoxRec and Tapology when verifiable). Each published record retains a source URL. No-contest counts are omitted from W-L-D display; absence of a record remains labelled rather than guessed.
